title: Double Hall algebras and derived equivalences revisited
summary: Let $\mathbb{k}$ be a finite field and $\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B}$ be $\mathbb{k}$-linear $\mathsf{Ext}$-finite hereditary abelian categories. A theorem of Cramer asserts that, under suitable assumptions, a derived equivalence $\mathcal{D}^b(\mathcal{A}) \!\longrightarrow\! \mathcal{D}^b(\mathcal{B})$ between two such categories induces an algebra isomorphism of the corresponding double Hall algebras $\mathsf{DH}_\mathcal{A} \!\longrightarrow\! \mathsf{DH}_\mathcal{B}$.
